## Scope

Which part of the repository?

- [ ] `[SA]` Semantic Algebra documentation
- [ ] `[PA]` Proportional Algebra documentation
- [ ] `[engine]` PA reference engine (`PA/pa_engine/`)
- [ ] `[meta]` repository governance (LICENSE, INDEX, etc.)

## Description

What is wrong? Be precise about file paths and line numbers where possible.

## Expected behaviour

What should happen instead? Cite the relevant chapter or definition.

## Reproduction

If applicable:
- the input expression
- the steps taken (S procedure, π procedure, ERT, engine command)
- the output observed
- the output expected

## Environment (engine bugs only)

- OS:
- Python version:
- relevant package versions:

Links to related issues, PRs, or chapters.
